chunks: When they hear idle talk they turn aside and say: 'To us our actions, to you yours. Peace on you; we do not look for the ignorant.'

key_terms.الْجَاهِلِينَ: The ignorant (those lacking spiritual or moral knowledge)

ai.seo_question: How do the pious respond to idle talk according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the spiritual discipline of 'disengagement' (i'rad), where the pious maintain inner tranquility amidst worldly chaos without necessarily severing social ties. The phrase 'peace be upon you' reflects a balanced approach of courteous detachment, ensuring that one's deeds remain pure from the contamination of ignorance (al-jahiliyyah). This behavior underscores the ethical ideal of preserving one's spiritual integrity while coexisting with the broader community.
